notes.title: Taco Gun Patch 1.1.0.0 now live!
notes.content:
Good evening from Floating Island Studios!

We just finished working on our latest patch, so let's get to it!

Here's what's changed for 1.1.0.0 and how it might impact your
Pepper-shooting habits.

- The Canyon level is now more forgiving to people not watching their step.
- We removed about 50% of the lava inside the Volcano, so it now only overflows ancient temples by about half of what it used to.
- General UI/Text bugfixing and tweaks, especially for non-english speaking users.
- Certain rare crashes should not occur anymore, if any crashes do occur, please be sure to post a screenshot on our Steam Discussion page or email us privately at support@floatingislandstudios.com


That's about it for this week,
See you around señores y señoritas!


Paris Laras
- Floating Island Studios

notes.title: First Patch? Heck yeah! [1.0.0.2]
notes.content:
We generally tweaked some post-release issues,
Including but not limited to:
- Some SFX and Music volumes for a better acoustic experience.
- Some SFX and Music timers for a better opticoacoustic experience. :P
- Some Text and UI elements to better adjust for the size of localized language options
- Some SFX and Music bugs
- Smoothed out our sweet-sweet volcano explosion to be more immersive, cause this is why you buy Taco Gun, Immersion.

That is all for now!

If you notice any bugs or weird behaviors, be sure to email us at 
support@floatingislandstudios.com
or Join the Discussion on our Community Boards!

- Paris Laras

Floating Island Studios
